title: dyschoriste vagans
intro: Dyschoriste vagans, commonly known as Blue Button, is a species of flowering plant in the family Acanthaceae. It is a perennial herb used in traditional medicine, particularly in the Caribbean, due to its health benefits, which include treating fever, colds, and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Dyschoriste vagans include its ability to reduce inflammation and kill bacteria, making it effective in treating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
